title: Quadruped
summary: QUAD'RUPED, adjective [Latin quadrupes; quadra, quatuor, four, and pes, foot.] Having four legs and feet. QUAD'RUPED, noun An animal having four legs and feet, as a horse, an ox, a lion, etc.
